entities.summary:
The Museum of the Asturian People is a museum in Gijón, Principality of Asturias, Spain. It is an open-air artspace containing Asturian popular art installations, large ethnographic items, and three buildings:Casa de los Valdes: temporary exhibition space
Casa de los González de la Vega: site of the International Bagpipe Museum, including a collection of traditional Asturian musical instruments. The Asturian Pavilion from the 1992 Universal Exposition of Seville, installed at the museum in 1994.
